title.en: Neural Media
title.zh: 神经媒体

intro.en: Everything we can find on K Allado-McDowell's concept of Neural Media: AI-era media that sense us, model us and generate content back at us. Videos, posts, essays, interviews, podcasts, talks, exhibitions and books in one timeline, newest first.
intro.zh: 这里汇集了关于 K Allado-McDowell「神经媒体」（Neural Media）概念的全部资料。神经媒体指 AI 时代那些感知我们、为我们建模，并反过来向我们生成内容的媒介。视频、帖子、文章、访谈、播客、演讲、展览和图书都收在同一条时间线上，最新的排在最前。

lead.en: K splits media into four types. Each takes about 30 years to go from birth to maturity, when it becomes the dominant form, and each is defined by a kind of space, a kind of content and a kind of identity.
lead.zh: K 把媒介分为四种类型。每种类型从诞生到成熟、成为主导媒介大约需要 30 年，并各自对应一种空间、一种内容和一种身份。

identity.zh: 把人归入不同的人口统计群体。

identity.en: Lets people build their own identity.
Treats us as “embeddings”: points in an AI system's statistical map that sense us, model us and generate content back at us.
identity.zh: 把我们当作「嵌入」（embedding），也就是 AI 系统统计图谱中的一个个点。这些系统感知我们、为我们建模，并反过来向我们生成内容。

notes.en: The neural phase also covers brain-computer interfaces and biological computing.
notes.zh: 神经媒体阶段还涵盖脑机接口与生物计算。

notes.en: By K's timeline it is only half-formed, so it can still be shaped.
notes.zh: 按照 K 的时间线，这一阶段才走到一半，因此仍有被塑造的空间。

notes.en: K's hope: point it at ecology and nonhuman intelligence, not just at modelling people.
notes.zh: K 希望让它面向生态与非人类智能，而不只是用来为人建模。

summary.en: K’s whole post reads “BCI x AI = neural media”. It quotes a thread by Trent McConaghy that defines neuroAI as “AI scaling laws x BCI” (decoding thought-to-text and thought-to-image with lots of data) and recommends Saturnin Pugnet’s manifesto Phase Lock. The clearest statement so far that K counts AI-decoded brain–computer interfaces as neural media. See section 06.
summary.zh: K 的帖子全文就是「BCI x AI = neural media」（脑机接口 × AI = 神经媒体）。它转引了 Trent McConaghy 的一条长帖：McConaghy 把 neuroAI 定义为「AI 规模定律 × 脑机接口」，即依靠海量数据把思维解码成文字和图像，并推荐了 Saturnin Pugnet 的宣言《Phase Lock》。这是 K 迄今最明确的表态：由 AI 解码的脑机接口属于神经媒体。详见第 06 部分。

title.en: Saturnin Pugnet, “Phase Lock”: a manifesto on brain-computer interfaces and human agency in the age of AI
title.zh: Saturnin Pugnet《Phase Lock》：关于脑机接口与 AI 时代人类能动性的宣言

summary.en: A roughly 40,000-word manifesto by Saturnin Pugnet (a founding member of World, formerly Worldcoin, and founder of the AI-safety nonprofit Factor Omega). It argues that AI is outpacing our ability to steer it through keyboards and screens (“the bandwidth problem”) and that brain–computer interfaces offer “alignment-by-integration”: the brain as a blueprint for aligned intelligence, neural data as a training signal for AI, and a wider channel between mind and machine. Its bet is that AI-style scaling (hardware, data, models) will work for brain decoding, led by consumer non-invasive devices; it also covers neurorights and cognitive liberty. Four parts and appendices. Version history on the site: v1.0 first published 2 Oct 2026, v1.1 14 Oct, v1.2 16 Oct, v1.3 23 Oct. Pugnet announced it on X and Substack on 6 Oct. Wider context: it never mentions K or the term neural media, but K’s 7 Oct post “BCI x AI = neural media” quotes Trent McConaghy’s thread recommending it.
summary.zh: Saturnin Pugnet 撰写的长篇宣言，约 4 万词。作者是 World（原 Worldcoin）的创始成员，也是 AI 安全非营利组织 Factor Omega 的创始人。文章认为，AI 的发展速度已经超出人类用键盘和屏幕去引导它的能力（作者称之为「带宽问题」），而脑机接口提供了一条「融合式对齐」的路径：大脑是对齐智能的蓝本，神经数据是训练 AI 的信号，脑机接口还能拓宽大脑与机器之间的通道。作者押注 AI 那套「更好的硬件、更多的数据、更大的模型」的扩展规律同样适用于大脑解码，而消费级非侵入式设备会是最快的路线；文中也讨论了神经权利和认知自由。全文分四部分，另有附录。网站上的版本记录：2026 年 10 月 2 日首发 v1.0，10 月 14 日 v1.1，10 月 16 日 v1.2，10 月 23 日 v1.3。作者于 10 月 6 日在 X 和 Substack 上正式发布。（相关背景：文中没有提到 K，也没有使用「神经媒体」一词；但 K 在 10 月 7 日发帖「BCI x AI = neural media」，转引的正是 Trent McConaghy 推荐这篇宣言的帖子。）

summary.en: In “Artistic Style Meets Artificial Intelligence” (Journal of Perceptual Imaging, 2021, with Hannu Töyrylä) they propose a post-phenomenology of “neural media”, meaning artistic practice with deep neural networks that unsettles intention and authorship. summary.zh: 他们在《Artistic Style Meets Artificial Intelligence》（《Journal of Perceptual Imaging》，2021 年，与 Hannu Töyrylä 合著）中提出「神经媒体」的后现象学：指借助深度神经网络进行的艺术实践，这种实践会动摇创作意图与作者身份。2023 年他们又发表论文，延续讨论把生成式 AI 视为「他者」以及在潜在空间中的创作旅程。（相关背景：这是更早、独立的术语用法，关注艺术家的创作过程，而非 K 的媒介时代框架。）

title.en: Brain implant decodes speech and gestures at once to drive a full-body avatar (UCSF, Nature Neuroscience)
title.zh: 脑植入设备同时解码语言和手势，驱动全身虚拟化身（加州大学旧金山分校，《自然·神经科学》）

summary.en: Edward Chang’s team at UCSF used machine-learning decoders on electrocorticography (ECoG) arrays over the motor cortex of people with paralysis. Two participants could speak and gesture (a wave, a thumbs-up) at the same time through a virtual avatar. Decoders worked better when trained on combined speech-and-gesture data, not on each separately. Wider context: BCI × AI research, not about K; see section 06.
summary.zh: 加州大学旧金山分校 Edward Chang 团队在瘫痪患者运动皮层表面放置皮层电极阵列（ECoG），用机器学习解码器读取信号。两名参与者能通过虚拟化身同时「说话」和做手势（挥手、竖大拇指）。研究发现，用「说话加手势」的混合数据训练的解码器，比分别训练的效果更好。（相关背景：属于脑机接口 × AI 研究，与 K 无直接关系，详见第 06 部分。）

source.zh: 《自然·神经科学》· 美国国立卫生研究院

title.en: Meta AI’s Brain2Qwerty: decoding typed sentences from non-invasive brain recordings (Nature Neuroscience)
title.zh: Meta AI 的 Brain2Qwerty：从非侵入式脑信号中解码打字内容（《自然·神经科学》）

summary.en: Peer-reviewed version of a February 2025 preprint. 35 healthy volunteers typed memorised sentences while EEG or MEG recorded their brains; a deep network plus a language model decoded the text. With MEG the average character error rate was 29% (18% for the best participants), versus 65% with EEG. No surgery, but not yet real time. Wider context: BCI × AI research, not about K.
summary.zh: 这是 2025 年 2 月预印本的同行评审正式版。35 名健康志愿者在打出背诵的句子时，用脑电（EEG）或脑磁（MEG）记录大脑活动，再由深度神经网络加语言模型解码出文字。使用脑磁图时平均字符错误率为 29%（表现最好的参与者为 18%），脑电图则为 65%。无需手术，但尚不能实时解码。（相关背景：属于脑机接口 × AI 研究，与 K 无直接关系。）

title.en: Merge Labs launches with a $252M seed round led by OpenAI
title.zh: Merge Labs 成立，完成 OpenAI 领投的 2.52 亿美元种子轮融资

summary.en: Merge Labs, a BCI research lab co-founded by Sam Altman (in a personal capacity), Alex Blania, Sandro Herbig and researchers Mikhail Shapiro, Tyson Aflalo and Sumner Norman, says it will connect with neurons “using molecules instead of electrodes” and ultrasound rather than brain implants. OpenAI wrote the largest check and will collaborate on scientific foundation models; its post says BCIs “will create a natural, human-centered way for anyone to seamlessly interact with AI.” Wider context: not about K.
summary.zh: Merge Labs 是一家脑机接口研究机构，联合创始人包括以个人身份参与的 Sam Altman、Alex Blania、Sandro Herbig，以及研究者 Mikhail Shapiro、Tyson Aflalo 和 Sumner Norman。公司表示将「用分子而非电极」与神经元连接，并用超声波等方式传递信息，避免在脑组织中植入设备。OpenAI 是最大的单笔投资方，并将合作开发科学基础模型；OpenAI 的博文写道，脑机接口将为任何人提供「自然、以人为本的方式，与 AI 无缝互动」。（相关背景：与 K 无直接关系。）

title.en: “Mind captioning”: turning brain activity into descriptive text (Horikawa, Science Advances)
title.zh: 「心智字幕」：把大脑活动转换成描述性文字（堀川友慈，《科学进展》）

summary.en: Tomoyasu Horikawa (NTT Communication Science Laboratories) decoded semantic features from fMRI while people watched or recalled short videos, then used a language model to evolve sentences that match them, producing coherent descriptions of what people saw or remembered. Wider context: AI language models reading the brain; not about K.
summary.zh: 日本 NTT 通信科学基础研究所的堀川友慈在受试者观看或回忆短视频时，用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）解码大脑中的语义特征，再借助语言模型逐步生成与之匹配的句子，得到对所见或所忆内容的连贯描述。（相关背景：AI 语言模型「读取」大脑的研究，与 K 无直接关系。）

title.en: Stanford team decodes “inner speech” from the motor cortex (Cell)
title.zh: 斯坦福团队从运动皮层解码「内心语言」（《细胞》）

summary.en: Erin Kunz and colleagues showed that implanted arrays in four people with paralysis pick up imagined, unspoken sentences, decoded in real time from a vocabulary of up to 125,000 words, with error rates of roughly 26–54%. They also tested a mental “password” that stops the device decoding private inner speech unless the user unlocks it. Wider context: not about K, but it raises the mental-privacy questions in section 06.
summary.zh: Erin Kunz 等研究者发现，四名瘫痪患者脑中植入的电极阵列能捕捉到想象中、未说出口的句子，并在最多 12.5 万词的词汇范围内实时解码，错误率约为 26% 至 54%。团队还测试了一种「意念密码」：用户不解锁，设备就不会解码其私密的内心语言。（相关背景：与 K 无直接关系，但涉及第 06 部分讨论的精神隐私问题。）

summary.en: At NVIDIA GTC, the stent-electrode BCI company described a brain foundation model “using generative pre-training techniques that learn directly from neural data” (CEO Tom Oxley), trained on de-identified data from its users. summary.zh: 在英伟达 GTC 大会上，这家以血管支架电极为技术路线的脑机接口公司介绍了一个大脑基础模型：CEO Tom Oxley 称它「采用生成式预训练技术，直接从神经数据中学习」，训练数据是用户经过去标识化处理的神经数据。（相关背景：这是名副其实用生物神经信号训练的人工神经网络，与 K 无直接关系。）

title.en: Synchron adds an OpenAI-powered chat feature to its brain implant
title.zh: Synchron 在脑植入系统中加入由 OpenAI 驱动的聊天功能

summary.en: People using Synchron’s Stentrode, which is placed through a blood vessel, can pick AI-suggested replies with brain signals instead of spelling each word. Patient Mark, who has ALS, told CNBC it saves him time and energy; Synchron said it shares no brain data with OpenAI. An early case of a large language model sitting directly in a BCI loop. Wider context: not about K.
summary.zh: Synchron 的 Stentrode 电极经血管植入。使用者可以用脑信号直接选择 AI 生成的回复建议，而不必逐字拼写。患有渐冻症（ALS）的患者 Mark 告诉 CNBC，这为他节省了时间和体力；Synchron 表示不会与 OpenAI 共享任何大脑数据。这是大语言模型直接进入脑机接口回路的早期案例。（相关背景：与 K 无直接关系。）

title.en: K Allado-McDowell, Song of the Ambassadors: an AI opera and neuroscience study, Lincoln Center

title.en: BCI × Neural Media
title.zh: 脑机接口与神经媒体

lead.en: K counts brain–computer interfaces as part of neural media: the word “neural” names both the networks in our heads and the networks in our machines. This section explains the link in plain language, gathers the ideas behind it and tracks real BCI news from 2024 to 2026, especially where AI models now read the brain.
lead.zh: K 把脑机接口也算作神经媒体的一部分：「神经」一词既指我们头脑中的神经网络，也指机器里的神经网络。本节用通俗的语言解释两者的联系，整理背后的思想资源，并追踪 2024 至 2026 年间真实的脑机接口进展，尤其是 AI 模型开始「读取」大脑的研究。

note.en: Only entries labelled “K’s framework” are K’s own statements. The other thinkers do not cite K; their placement here is our reading of how they connect.
note.zh: 只有标为「K 的框架」的条目是 K 本人的观点。其他思想家并未引用 K，把他们放在这里，是本站对二者关联的解读。

title.en: A two-minute primer
title.zh: 两分钟读懂脑机接口

text.en: A brain–computer interface reads signals from the nervous system and turns them into commands, text or speech, so a person can use a computer without hands or voice. Some devices can also stimulate the brain, writing signals back in.
text.zh: 脑机接口读取神经系统发出的信号，把它们转换成指令、文字或语音，让人不用手、不用开口就能操作电脑。有些设备还能刺激大脑，把信号「写」回去。

text.en: Implants (Neuralink, Paradromics, Precision; Synchron’s Stentrode goes in through a blood vessel) get clear signals but need surgery. Non-invasive tools such as EEG caps, MEG and fMRI scanners, and the ultrasound methods Merge Labs is pursuing, need no surgery but read blurrier signals.
text.zh: 植入式设备（Neuralink、Paradromics、Precision；Synchron 的 Stentrode 则经血管植入）信号清晰，但需要手术。非侵入式方法，如脑电帽、脑磁图和功能性磁共振扫描仪，以及 Merge Labs 正在研究的超声波方法，不用手术，但读到的信号更模糊。

text.en: Brain signals are noisy. Machine-learning decoders map patterns of activity to words, images or movements, and they increasingly borrow the models behind chatbots and image generators: language models fill in likely words, and diffusion models turn decoded features into pictures.
text.zh: 大脑信号充满噪声。机器学习解码器把大脑活动的模式对应到文字、图像或动作上，而且越来越多地借用聊天机器人和图像生成器背后的模型：语言模型补全最可能的词语，扩散模型把解码出的特征还原成图像。

text.en: Brain recordings can reveal health, attention and emotional states. Chile, several US states and UNESCO have begun to protect “neural data” and “mental privacy” in law.
text.zh: 大脑记录可能透露一个人的健康、注意力和情绪状态。智利、美国多个州以及联合国教科文组织已开始在法律和规范中保护「神经数据」和「精神隐私」。

title.en: Theory: from neural nets to brains
title.zh: 理论：从神经网络到大脑

source.zh: K 在 Long Now 的演讲，2025 年 2 月 25 日

line.en: K defines neural media as all media built on networks of neurons, biological or mathematical. Long Now’s summary of the talk puts it plainly: our brains are neural media, “the first of their kind, but not the last”. In the talk K lists EEG brain–computer interfaces beside the Oura Ring as biometric tools that make “a mathematical image of you” for machine learning.
line.zh: K 把神经媒体定义为一切建立在神经元网络之上的媒介，无论是生物的还是数学的。Long Now 对这场演讲的介绍说得很直白：我们的大脑就是神经媒体，「第一种，但不是最后一种」。K 在演讲中把脑电脑机接口和 Oura 智能戒指并列，称它们都是生物识别工具，会为机器学习生成「一个关于你的数学图像」。

name.zh: 用脑电波驱动 AI 影像

line.en: K’s opera was also a neuroscience study: an EEG cap fed a performer’s brainwaves into AI-generated projections, while scientists recorded the audience. K recalls this kind of work at the start of the Long Now talk. K’s question at the time: “could you actually compose with states of consciousness?”
line.zh: K 的这部歌剧同时也是一项神经科学实验：脑电帽把一位表演者的脑电波输入 AI 生成的影像，科学家同时记录观众的数据。K 在 Long Now 演讲开头回忆的正是这类创作。K 当时的提问是：「能不能直接用意识状态来作曲？」

source.zh: K，《设计神经媒体》，柏林 Gropius Bau，2023

line.en: K traces how McCulloch, Pitts and Turing treated the brain as a computer in order to build brain-like computers. K names two responses: seeing models as selves, or seeing selves as models (citing Adam Safron’s world-modelling theory of consciousness, which draws on the free-energy principle and active inference). K proposes instead that selves and models are both relational structures in a wider ecology of meaning.
line.zh: K 回溯了麦卡洛克、皮茨和图灵如何把大脑当作计算机，进而造出类脑计算机。K 指出人们的两种反应：把模型看作自我，或把自我看作模型（文中引用了 Adam Safron 的「整合世界建模」意识理论，该理论借鉴了自由能原理和主动推理）。K 则主张：自我和模型都是更大的意义生态中的关系结构。

name.zh: 「脑机接口 × AI = 神经媒体」

source.zh: K 在 X 上发帖，2026 年 10 月 7 日

line.en: K’s whole comment on Trent McConaghy’s thread “neuroAI = AI scaling laws x BCI”, which itself recommends Saturnin Pugnet’s Phase Lock.
line.zh: 这是 K 对 Trent McConaghy 长帖「neuroAI = AI 规模定律 × 脑机接口」的全部评论，而那条长帖推荐的正是 Saturnin Pugnet 的《Phase Lock》。

line.en: Keyboards and screens are too narrow a channel to steer advanced AI (“the bandwidth problem”). BCI could couple human intent to AI directly, as a blueprint, a training signal and a wider pipe. The bet is that AI’s scaling laws carry over to brain decoding. It does not cite K.
line.zh: 键盘和屏幕这条通道太窄，不足以引导越来越强大的 AI（作者称之为「带宽问题」）。脑机接口可以把人的意图直接接入 AI，同时充当蓝本、训练信号和更宽的通道。作者押注 AI 的扩展规律同样适用于大脑解码。文中没有引用 K。

source.en: Takagi & Nishimoto, CVPR 2023 · Tang et al., Nature Neuroscience, 1 May 2023
source.zh: 高木优、西本伸志，CVPR 2023 · Tang 等，《自然·神经科学》，2023 年 5 月 1 日

line.en: Two 2023 studies used fMRI with generative AI: Stable Diffusion to reconstruct images people saw, and a GPT-based decoder to recover the gist of stories people heard or imagined. Artificial neural nets reading biological ones, the two meanings of “neural” meeting.
line.zh: 2023 年的两项研究把功能性磁共振成像与生成式 AI 结合起来：一项用 Stable Diffusion 重建受试者看到的图像，另一项用基于 GPT 的解码器还原受试者听到或想象的故事大意。人工神经网络开始读取生物神经网络，「神经」的两层含义在这里交汇。

source.en: Rafael Yuste, Sara Goering et al., Nature, 9 Nov 2017
source.zh: Rafael Yuste、Sara Goering 等，《自然》，2017 年 11 月 9 日

line.en: “Four ethical priorities for neurotechnologies and AI”: privacy and consent, agency and identity, augmentation, and bias. The paper behind the neurorights movement and Chile’s 2021 constitutional amendment.
line.zh: 《神经技术与 AI 的四项伦理优先事项》：隐私与知情同意、能动性与身份认同、能力增强，以及偏见。这篇文章是神经权利运动的起点，也推动了智利 2021 年的修宪。

source.en: Nita Farahany, The Battle for Your Brain, 2023

line.en: Argues for a right to mental privacy, freedom of thought and self-determination as neurotech becomes the “universal controller” for our devices. Farahany later co-chaired the expert group that drafted UNESCO’s 2025 neurotechnology standard.
line.zh: 随着神经技术成为我们操控各种设备的「通用控制器」，作者主张确立精神隐私、思想自由和自我决定的权利。Farahany 后来担任联合国教科文组织专家组联合主席，主持起草了 2025 年的神经技术伦理标准。

source.zh: Andy Clark 与 David Chalmers，《分析》期刊，1998

line.en: The classic argument that a tool reliably coupled to a person, such as a notebook, can count as part of their mind. BCIs and AI models make the question of where a mind ends far less hypothetical.
line.zh: 这是一个经典论证：一件与人稳定耦合的工具，比如笔记本，可以算作心智的一部分。脑机接口和 AI 模型让「心智的边界在哪里」不再只是思想实验。
